notes.title: Lust Academy Final: Major Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/e62da8d51f0d1ef5d62f9d44c25e76a38b22be40.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Over the past few months, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you (our amazing players), and we’ve heard a recurring theme: the ending of Lust Academy left some of you with unanswered questions.[/p][p]So… we’ve decided to fix that.[/p][p]Today, we’re releasing the major update, which adds even more depth to the story and gives you a clearer picture of what really happened at the end of your magical journey. [/p][p]Consider it our way of saying thanks for sticking with us and for caring enough to share your thoughts.[/p][p]What's new in:[/p][list][*][p]15 brand new mini scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Around 200 new renders[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and minor improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the new content, and don’t hesitate to drop us a line, change a review, or leave your thoughts in the discussions![/p][p][i]Love,
Bear in the Night Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Lust Academy Season 4 – Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Big News, Mages! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/9737fb5ecc2fd1548b46dd8e2a1de4990aac7df9.png[/img]

It’s time to mark your calendars because [b]Lust Academy Season 4[/b] officially launches on [b]May 8[/b]! We've been working hard to make this the biggest and most exciting season yet, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

[h3]Why You Should Wishlist Now:[/h3]
Wishlisting isn’t just a small button click—it’s a huge help for us as developers! The more wishlists we have, the better our chances of reaching more players and making Lust Academy even better. If you’re excited about Season 4, please add it to your wishlist today and ask your friends to do the same!

[h3]Still Haven’t Played the Demo?[/h3]
You still have a chance to play [b]the Season 4 Demo[/b], but time is running out! The demo will disappear before launch, so now’s the perfect moment to dive in and get a taste of what’s coming.
